faq.title: Help & Support
faq.a1: After your meal, show your QR code in the Earn section at the restaurant. You earn 10 points for every €1 spent. Points are credited to your wallet.
faq.a2: Earn shows your customer code. Show it at the restaurant to link your purchase to your loyalty account.
faq.q3: How do I redeem a voucher?
faq.a3: In Rewards, pick a money voucher you can afford (e.g. 500 pts = €5) and tap Redeem. Show the voucher QR at the counter on your next visit.
faq.a4: Validity rules depend on the programme. Check conditions at the restaurant or contact support.
faq.q5: Can I use points at all restaurants?
faq.a5: Your balance is shared across JD group restaurants. Money vouchers may be valid at participating locations.
faq.q6: How do I change my details?
faq.a6: Go to Account → Edit Profile to update your name, phone and app language.
faq.a7: On the sign-in page, tap Forgot password and enter your email to receive a reset link, or contact support.
faq.a8: See the Privacy Policy under Account. Data is processed in line with applicable law.
faq.q9: How do I delete my account?
faq.a9: Go to Account → Delete account. This permanently removes your app profile. You can also email grupopie@grupopie.com.

legal.intro: These documents explain how the Chef Domingos loyalty app works and how we handle your personal data. For questions, contact grupopie@grupopie.com.
legal.termsS1: By creating an account or using the Chef Domingos app, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the app.
legal.termsS2: The app lets you earn and redeem loyalty points and vouchers at participating restaurants. Points, catalogues and rules are operated with our loyalty technology partner (LKM). Balances and offers may change according to programme rules.
legal.termsS3: You must provide accurate registration details and keep your password confidential. You are responsible for activity under your account. You may delete your account at any time from Account → Delete account.
legal.termsS4: You must not misuse the app, attempt to manipulate points or vouchers, or interfere with restaurant operations or our systems.
legal.termsS5: For support related to the app or loyalty programme, contact grupopie@grupopie.com.
legal.privacyS1: The data controller for this app is Grupo PIE / JD restaurant network (Chef Domingos), reachable at grupopie@grupopie.com.
legal.privacyS2: We process account data (name, email, optional phone), authentication identifiers, preferred language, notification preferences, loyalty card identifiers, points and transaction history, and vouchers claimed in the app.
legal.privacyS3: We use this data to create and manage your account, run the loyalty programme (earn/redeem), show your balance and history, validate vouchers with staff, send communications you opt into, and improve the service. Processing is based on contract performance, legitimate interests in operating the programme, and consent where required (for example marketing).
legal.privacyS4: We share necessary data with our infrastructure provider (Supabase) and loyalty partner (LKM) to register your card, authenticate loyalty API calls, and process points/vouchers. Restaurant staff may see voucher codes when validating offers. We do not sell your personal data.
legal.privacyS5: We keep account and loyalty data while your account is active and for a limited period afterwards where required for legal, accounting or fraud-prevention reasons. We use industry-standard measures such as encrypted transport and access controls. No method of transmission is 100% secure.
legal.privacyS6: Depending on applicable law (including GDPR), you may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability or objection. You can update profile details in the app and delete your account under Account → Delete account. You may also contact grupopie@grupopie.com or your local supervisory authority.
